callback_scope: global allocator callbacks after System returns; process-wide across threads; excludes RSS, object-owned memory, allocator-internal realloc overlap, and latency
ownership_scope: phase labels describe retained handles at callback-order boundaries; live bytes are process-global allocator counters and are not object-retention measurements

phases.label: baseline_before_inputs
phases.live_owners: region acquired; corpus bytes remain outside the lifecycle; no source Arcs or sink

phases.label: prepared_inputs_and_sink
phases.live_owners: source-backed caller InstrumentedSource Arcs, temporary ReadAt Arcs, and reserved bounded sink

phases.label: opened_documents
phases.live_owners: source-backed presentation view and editor, caller source Arcs, and sink

phases.label: planned
phases.live_owners: source-backed view, editor, source-retaining plan, caller source Arcs, and sink

phases.label: published
phases.live_owners: source-backed view, plan, publication result, caller source Arcs, and exact output sink; editor is consumed by publication

phases.label: drop_result
phases.live_owners: source-backed view, plan, caller source Arcs, and exact output sink

phases.label: drop_plan
phases.live_owners: source-backed view, caller source Arcs, and exact output sink

phases.label: drop_document_handles
phases.live_owners: source InstrumentedSource Arcs and exact output sink; source-backed view is released

phases.label: drop_caller_source_arcs
phases.live_owners: exact output sink only; caller InstrumentedSource Arcs are released

phases.label: drop_sink
phases.live_owners: no lifecycle-owned source, document, plan, publication result, or sink handles; process baseline may differ
